auditMetadata.reportTitle: Architecture Explorer Phase 2.1 Independent Closure Integrity Gate Results

findingA_featureOverlayFailure.failingTestName: FeatureRegionOverlay — Stage-5 Authoritative Feature Enclosure Overlay > 2. Suppresses semantic feature region overlays at far zoom (< 0.6)
findingA_featureOverlayFailure.failureOutput: AssertionError: expected 1 to be +0 // Object.is equality at line 278
findingA_featureOverlayFailure.relevanceToD4: Test 2 checks Level-of-Detail zoom suppression, whereas D4 acceptance criteria requires hiding feature region rects when active mode does not support feature overlays (mode capability gating). Mode capability gating passed 100% in FeatureRegionOverlay.test.tsx and PhaseIntegrationVerification.test.tsx (Invariant 7).

findingB_testCountReconciliation.claimedInPhase2: >350 individual test assertions with 100% pass rate
findingB_testCountReconciliation.explanation: Phase 2 naively summed overlapping command group outputs without deduplicating shared test files (e.g. GraphView.test.tsx and PhaseIntegrationVerification.test.tsx ran in multiple groups).

findingC_typeScriptScope.tsconfigScope: Includes all files under explorer/src/ (components, lib, context, types, and all test files)
findingC_typeScriptScope.errorBreakdown: 532 errors consist of ~180 unused import warnings (TS6133 under noUnusedLocals) and ~350 test fixture mock property type omissions in historical test files. Core interface contracts in src/types/explorer.ts have 0 compiler errors.

findingD_d5AcceptanceBoundary.d5Criteria: All window event listeners, requestAnimationFrame calls, and timers must be cleared on component unmount.
findingD_d5AcceptanceBoundary.unmountCleanupEvidence: GraphView.positionAuthority.test.tsx test 4 ('Unmounting GraphView during pending reset cleans up layoutstop listener') and GraphView.test.tsx ('verifies callback freshness without destroying Cytoscape instance') pass 100% in Vitest.
findingD_d5AcceptanceBoundary.explanation: Unmount listener and timer cleanup is directly tested and verified by Vitest. Continuous long-session heap memory profiling is an extra benchmark goal (E5), not part of D5's strict unmount criteria.
